# Now

Gives the current date and time in UTC.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
Now()
```

## Returns

String. The current instant as an ISO 8601 string in UTC, to the millisecond, in the form `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.fffZ`, for example `"2024-01-15T09:30:00.000Z"`. Never null.

## Remarks

Reads the clock: each call can give a different result.

## Example

`Now()` returns a string such as `"2024-01-15T09:30:00.000Z"`.

Effect: non-deterministic. See [Function Effects](/docs/language/functions/function-effects).
